To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the openness of national funding programmes is positively related to the quality and performance, but negatively related to the size, of the national research system, while the degree of national integration into EU programmes and research collaboration does neither increase nor decrease the openness.
openness is determined by the quality of national research and the level of international collaboration.

the openness of a national research funding programme is determined by (1) the national research performance and the quality of the national research system, and (2) the degree of national integration into EU research funding programmes and collaboration networks, and (3) the programme characteristics.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a specific aspect of national research systems and their integration into the EU research area.
the determinants of openness in national research funding programmes, and the role of national R&D systems therein.
the determinants of programme openness in national research systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
national openness in research is not determined by national openness in research collaboration, but by national openness in the research system.

the openness of national R&D funding programmes is determined by the quality of national research and innovation systems, whereas the openness of EU funding is determined by the integration into EU research collaboration.

openness of national R&D programs is not only determined by the characteristics of the national research and innovation system, but also by the characteristics of national funding programs themselves.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
national research quality is the most important determinant of the openness of R&D funding programmes.
the openness of national R&D funding programmes is determined by national research quality and performance.

openness of national research is not only determined by the characteristics of national research systems and their integration into the European research area, but also by the quality of national research.
The main takeaway from our work is that
national research performance and quality matter for the openness of national programmes.
the openness of national programmes is not only determined by EU funding programmes and the degree of integration of national funding programmes in these EU funding programmes.
the openness of research funding programmes is determined by national characteristics, which are not directly related to the EU research and innovation policy.
